description: Add Actual Talktime widget to admin.html and tl.html Disposition Stats section, calculating total recording duration for previous day with per-agent filtering
steps: Step 1: Add a pure Node.js audio duration calculator in server.js. Since we cannot install npm packages or use ffprobe, write a function getAudioDuration(filePath) that reads file headers to estimate duration. Support MP3 (parse frame headers to get bitrate, duration = fileSize / bitrate), WAV (read RIFF header for sample rate and data chunk size), and for other formats fall back to a rough estimate. The function should return duration in seconds. Place it near the recordings section (around line 3700).

Step 2: Modify the POST /api/recordings/upload endpoint (server.js line 3762) to calculate and store duration for each uploaded file. After files are saved to disk, call getAudioDuration() on each file and add a 'duration' field (in seconds) to each recording object before pushing to appState.recordings.

Step 3: Add a new API endpoint GET /api/recordings/talktime that accepts query params: agent (optional, filter by agent name), date (optional, defaults to yesterday's date in YYYY-MM-DD format). It should: filter recordings for the specified date, sum up all duration values, return { totalSeconds, hours, minutes, recordingCount, date, agent }.

Step 4: Add the Actual Talktime widget card to admin.html inside the dispo-stats-grid div (after the DND card, around line 533). Add a new dispo-stat-card with id='adminStatsTalktime' showing hours and minutes. Style it with a phone/headphone indicator color (e.g. teal #0d9488). The card label should say 'Actual Talktime' with a tooltip 'Previous day total recording duration for selected agent'.

Step 5: Add JavaScript in admin.html to fetch /api/recordings/talktime on page load and when agent filter changes (reuse the existing adminStatsAgentFilter select). Update the adminStatsTalktime element with the fetched hours/minutes. Format as 'Xh Ym'. Call this function fetchTalktime() and invoke it from the existing onAdminAgentFilterChange() function and on initial load.

Step 6: Add the same Actual Talktime widget card to tl.html inside BOTH dispo-stats-grid sections: the 'My Disposition Stats' section (line 1132) for the agent's own view, AND the TL Mode admin-like 'Disposition Stats' section (line 1502). Use id='myStatsTalktime' for the personal stats and id='adminStatsTalktime' for the TL Mode admin view. Add corresponding JavaScript to fetch and display talktime.
Step 7: Run syntax verification: unset NODE_OPTIONS && node --check server.js
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/recordings/talktime endpoint exists and returns talktime data
Audio duration is calculated and stored on upload for supported formats (MP3, WAV, OGG, WebM, M4A)
Admin.html shows an 'Actual Talktime' card in the Disposition Stats grid
TL.html shows 'Actual Talktime' card in both personal and TL Mode disposition stats
Talktime widget shows previous day's data by default
Widget respects the agent filter dropdown
node --check server.js passes with no errors
verification: grep -n 'talktime\|Talktime' server.js public/admin/index.html public/tl/index.html | wc -l (should be > 10)
